name: B10-0034/2024 (Renew) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Venezuela's July 2024 presidential election. It says the results announced by the electoral authority cannot be trusted because the detailed voting records were never published. It says the available records show the opposition candidate, Edmundo González, won by a large margin. It calls for those records to be published, for political prisoners to be freed, and for sanctions on the government to be extended.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and set of demands.
- **Who it affects:** Venezuela's government, opposition figures, detained protesters and EU citizens held there.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its demands to the EU Council, Commission and others; they decide whether to act.
